title: VTC→FileNode guide: recordings as FileNodes
description: Section on organizing recordings in FileNode tree. When VTCRecording reaches state available, server creates a FileNode pointing to the blobId. Directory structure (e.g., /Recordings/2026-06-05-Standup.mp4). FileNode metadata (duration, participants, call subject). Access control: who can see recordings post-call. JSON example of VTCRecording→FileNode creation.
